en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Al Musna,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said that Ali<sup>asws</sup> disliked the pictures in the houses’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from al-Muthanna’ who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
Ali, Alayhi al-Salam, disliked the existence of pictures in houses.’”
